depends_on.name: ingredient_id
depends_on.documentation: What went in, in the order of `value.ingredients` (entry k describes edge k; the order carries no other meaning). A stock you made is a formulation.

depends_on.name: product_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional: the bought product/lot, for a mixture bought ready-made (PBS tablets, saline).

fields.name: value
fields.documentation: What you make: its ingredients and whole-mixture properties.

fields.name: ingredients
fields.documentation: Exactly one entry per `ingredient_id` edge, same order (0-based). Store what the source gave -- an added amount, a final concentration, or both only if both were given.

fields.name: mass
fields.documentation: Mass, optional.

fields.name: grams
fields.documentation: Canonical mass value -- the normalised, cross-document comparable number.

fields.name: source_unit
fields.documentation: The unit exactly as given by the source (lossless provenance).

fields.name: source_value
fields.documentation: The number as given by the source, in `source_unit`.

fields.name: approximate
fields.documentation: True when the value is approximate.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.documentation: The bound on this value: the true value lies between `value - minus` and `value + plus`, in the canonical unit (grams). Asymmetric when the uncertainty is one-sided (a clock time written to the minute is minus 0 / plus 59 s). ABSENT means no tolerance is stated. A bound, not a standard deviation (CHANGE 7).

fields.name: minus
fields.documentation: How far BELOW the stated value the true value may lie, in the canonical unit (grams) (for a time: how much EARLIER). Non-negative.

fields.name: plus
fields.documentation: How far ABOVE the stated value the true value may lie, in the canonical unit (grams) (for a time: how much LATER). Non-negative.
